purpose: Prove Portfolio Brain produces one independently verifiable real-world outcome without weakening authority, cost, privacy, or durability controls.

primary_uncertainty.question: Can the current FreightRecovery free-audit offer produce a genuine buyer engagement and a verifiable audit/recovery outcome?
primary_uncertainty.next_admissible_action: Monitor existing contacted cohort for genuine replies; keep audit intake/delivery readiness measurable; do not send or draft new email without explicit authorization.
primary_uncertainty.stop_condition: A genuine buyer response creates an authorized bounded audit path, or the sprint window closes with no verified external outcome.

guardrails: No follow-up to an existing contact without a genuine human reply.
No new email drafting or sending without explicit user authorization.
No customer communication, money movement, trading, deployment, merge, or consequential child-facing ACT by autonomous Portfolio Brain.
No paid/model/API budget expansion during the validation sprint without separate explicit authorization.
While the repository is public, store sanitized counts/hashes/references only; no customer identities, message bodies, credentials, or private operational payloads.
